title: Hephaestus mesh dispatch envelope hi/v1
description: Versioned dispatch packet for the Hephaestus automation loop on the HomericIntelligence mesh. It encodes the payload and pointer fields whose design context is Proposed ADR-013 §3 and Proposed ADR-020 §6. Worker lookup behavior is outside this schema. New contract versions get a new schema file — never edit this one in place.

msg_id.description: Globally unique message id for idempotent handling (ADR-013 §3).

repo.description: GitHub repository the task belongs to, as {org}/{name} (ADR-020 §6).

issue.description: GitHub issue number that is the single source of truth for this task (ADR-020 §6).

branch.description: Git branch holding code truth for this task (ADR-020 §6).

base_branch.description: Branch to base work on; defaults to the repository trunk when absent.

blocked_by.description: Issue numbers this task depends on (ADR-013 §3).

domain.description: Dispatch domain; pipeline or research today (ADR-013 role-addressed dispatch), extensible to new domains without a schema bump.

role.description: Role name addressed by the dispatch subject hi.myrmidon.{domain}.{role}.task.{task_id} (ADR-013 §2).

stage.description: Loop stage this dispatch targets. The M0 schema freeze encodes the stage values described by Proposed ADR-020 §2; runtime ordering and transitions are outside this schema. The Learn stage is dispatched post-merge on an aux queue and has no first-class dispatch value.

attempt.description: 1-based attempt counter for this stage dispatch; part of the idempotency preamble key (ADR-013 §4).

plan_cycles.description: Full plan -> plan-review cycles before exhaustion (default 2).

pr_review_hard.description: Hard ceiling across all PR-review retries for one item (default 6).

merge.description: Merger-agent retry budget (default 5; design context: Proposed ADR-020 §3).

budgets.description: Per-stage retry-budget counters carried in the envelope. Proposed ADR-020 §6 describes candidate decrement and exhaustion semantics; runtime behavior is outside this schema.

verdict.description: Stage outcome carried forward so downstream stages can chain on it (e.g. merger reacts to implementation-go/no-go). Null while no verdict exists yet.

reason.description: Human-readable cause of the no-go outcome.

evidence.description: Verbatim failing evidence (log excerpts, check names, review threads) for the receiving agent.

remediation.description: Optional remediation data for a no-go outcome. Proposed ADR-020 §3 describes candidate routing semantics; runtime publication is outside this schema. Present only on remediation packets, never on forward dispatches.
